claude-opus-5-5.note: A polished, cohesive editorial take: serif display type with mono labels, a warm dusk palette, a strong illustrated hero and a well-crafted timetable and fare cards. It still leans on a familiar premium-template structure, and the 'neon city' theme is muted rather than truly electric.

openai-gpt-6-sol.note: A polished, distinctive rail-travel page with every required section; the muted city illustration does not quite deliver the promised neon atmosphere.
